decisionBody:
Root read the exact8874 v2 revision-contract.md, all77 slot entries/28 distinct contracts, actual112 reference shape, and accepted e50 native transport/peer_floor.go. This is a REAL unresolved referent-wire gap, not existing production acceptance. APPROVE a NEW PACKAGE-LOCAL implementation-wire PROPOSAL for K1 and subsequent actual code+contract review, with the concrete constraints below. Continue current parser/schema/graph work now; do not return to a generic approval loop. Frozen8874/17 schema blobs/old fixtures and e50/runtime stay unchanged. Live CP/worker contract/verifier/key bindings remainNULL/HOLD; existing null slots MUST BLOCK real acceptance.
1 NORMALIZED codec for the27 non-native contract IDs only. Keep closed envelope {body,signer}; signer EXACT {role,keySPKISHA256,signatureHex}; body closed per fixed contractId (not caller-selected mode). body schemaVersion constant saintvision-migration-proof-envelope:1, contractId exact slot, typedSubject exact closed recipe, observedAt and validUntil strict real UTC whole-second RFC3339 strings. Add migrationId and operationId REQUIRED ONLY for freshness.mode=fresh, compared to authoritative current operation/migration independently of typedSubject. For immutable-provenance and validity-bounded-approval contracts, OMIT/FORBID both operation fields: do not force old build/CI/image/review artifacts or G2/reduced-plan approvals to be reissued per runtime operation, and do not create circular approval dependency. Existing typedSubject exact component/source/image/cohort/registry/planSubject recipes remain mandatory. G2 uses its existing cohort+selection+registry subject, not an invented final-envelope subject. Extra/missing fields reject, no null/empty sentinel context, no wire-controlled freshness mode.
2 PROTECT signer metadata too. Signature input is EXACT slot-pinned signatureDomainASCII || single00 || C2({body:body,signer:{role:role,keySPKISHA256:keySPKISHA256}}), NOT only C2(body). signatureHex itself excluded from this protected projection. Pure strict Ed25519 with existing accepted strictness requirement (canonical A/R, prime-order nonidentity points,S<L, no prehash/context variant); stdlib success alone does not prove all those point checks. Raw public key32bytes; SPKI hash=SHA256(canonical x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(Ed25519 public key) DER), not hash of PEM/raw32. Signature exactly64bytes lowercase128hex. Role,scope,key,producer,domain,contract,codec and reviewed verifier must be fixed by trusted external registration, no self-described grant/producer authority or dynamic callback/plugin. The key must be explicitly authorized for that role and exact Node/cohort/component scope; signature alone is insufficient. New normalizer cannot wrap/re-sign old evidence and claim its old producer signed the new envelope.
3 ARTIFACT IDENTITY: choose SHA256(EXACT REFERENT BYTES) uniformly, not an implicit raw-vs-C2 fallback. For NEW normalized envelopes, require referent bytes equal C2(full envelope) exactly (no LF/whitespace aliases); therefore raw hash and C2 hash coincide. Keep the original supplied bytes, compare artifactSHA256 to their raw hash, parse/strict-schema/verify and compare ALL reference metadata to authenticated or explicitly codec-derived values. contractSHA256 is SHA256 exact pinned contract file bytes, matching external registry; schema/codec/source hashes must be pinned and exact. scopeSHA256 remains SHA256(C2(typedSubject)) INCLUDING kind and does not replace full expected-subject equality. Caller cannot select digest algorithm. Publish actual per-contract schema/codec/field-map/domain/hash/freshness descriptors, exact raw contract hashes and vectors as new proposal assets; dummy f46.../null current registry are not real pins.
4 THREE EXISTING freshness semantics must be preserved, not all converted into fresh<=120s. Fresh: actual trusted current clock, observedAt<=validUntil, now within validity, age<=min(plan maxEvidenceAge,120s), future skew<=30s, current exact lease/operation and subject. Validity-bounded approvals: current now/plan expiry/nonrevocation and exact reduced-plan or G2 subject, no120s age requirement. Immutable provenance: authenticated original event/publication time and validity then, plus CURRENT authenticated accepted publication/source/artifact and nonrevocation state; no new operation fields, no treating it as current live Node evidence. Missing authenticated publication/revocation context BLOCKS. Historical authentication outputs cannot be used as fresh operational proof. No plan/request clock override, bool trusted=true adapter, artificial re-signing or falling back to original dummy fixtures for crypto. Test clocks/keys remain explicit synthetic tests only; K1 accepts trusted context structurally, K2 must provide actual trusted producers.
5 NATIVE M2 codec is FIXED ONLY for saintvision-proof-node-floor-v2:1. Preserve actual saintvision-node-peer-policy-floor:2 flat body+nodeSignature, existing domain saintvision/node-peer-policy-floor/v2 +00 and CanonicalPeerFloorBody of all exact native signed fields EXCLUDING nodeSignature. observedAt is existing signed Unix SECONDS exact-safe-int, NOT the new RFC3339 string; no wire or producer change. Verify actual signature and original registered unchanged CA/certificate DER/Node identity/current trust and key scope; certificateDER_SHA256 must equal actual supplied authenticated certificate DER. SPKI digest from that cert, not a wrapper's asserted key. Reference observedAt is deterministic UTC whole-second conversion of signed Unix seconds. Native M2 has NO signed validUntil/migrationId/operationId/daemon/container/plan fields: do not claim those are Node-signed. Define reference validUntil as deterministic minimum of observedAt+min(plan maxEvidenceAge,120s), authenticated certificate NotAfter floored to whole seconds, authenticated current plan expiry and actual current lease validity when used as fresh operational proof. This is explicit VERIFIED DERIVED BOUND, not a signed claim; reference must equal computed bound and now must satisfy all source validity rules. Nonpositive/missing/untrusted bound BLOCKS. For immutable historical M2 authentication, preserve original bytes/history and typed historical result only; do not claim fresh validity or synthesize a current lease. Current use requires fresh nonce from externally trusted current operation challenge bound to exact migration/operation/member/epoch; plan-provided nonce is insufficient. Keep native raw artifactSHA256 including existing response transport bytes/LF if present; never normalized re-sign/rewrite or sha(C2) substitution. Derive native typedSubject ONLY from authenticated native fields+certificate/known member identity; daemon/container/ExecID joins require their separate actual host inspection/exec proofs. No native->normalized fallback on failure and no normalized object may satisfy native contract.
6 Fresh/provenance/approval/native dispatch is exact registry+contractId+slot, not input label. Resolve EACH of77slots and112references by actual provided bytes through pinned descriptors; absent refs/extra foreign keys/codec/slot/key/scope/metadata mismatch fails before any accepted output. Same referent may legitimately be used by several compatible fixed slots with the same complete subject; do not fabricate a current operation signature on an archival referent. Rebuild separate REAL-CRYPTO TEST fixtures from explicit ephemeral keys and correctly signed current typed subjects; rebind all artifact/contract/scope/reference/graph hashes and label original195 shape/dummy fixtures non-crypto. Test wrong and altered signerrole/SPKI even when cryptographic key reused in malicious fixtures, unknown/unregistered codec, alternate envelope whitespace/LF/rawhash, current vs archived mode substitution, expired/revoked publication/approval, valid signature with wrong operation/cohort/component/subject, wrong native nonce/cert/raw bytes/derived expiry plus cross-codec replacement. Test strict Ed25519 adversarial vectors, not just random tamper.
7 Implementation stays authorized package-local K1 pure offline verification/tests only (new resources under migrationverify allowed), not changes to inv-node/transport/peerfloor/B/DB/PKI/keys/Engine/SSH/guest/schedules. New proof wire/descriptors are PROPOSED_CODE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, not an already accepted canonical live contract. Root418 design registry rawSHA a0a05427 stays unchanged; attach this additive gap/decision to unique K1 History/Evidence and preserve original limitations. On actual published code SHA with exact own CI, ONE independent Claude review must cover BOTH new wire and code/crypto/native adapter. Treat any external trust/producers still unavailable as BLOCK, not completion. Do not mark all40future product cases complete from offline fixtures. Continue independent implementation and report concrete additional incompatibility only if actual.
